remarks: Historic Landmark Queen Anne Victorian House C.1899 w/beautiful architectural detail. The house is situated in the heart of thriving Saugatuck Area of Westport. This home has been lovingly maintained and updated. Grand windows drench the home  with  light... featuring 9 foot ceilings on the main floor. There are 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, and a den that could be a 4th bedroom.  a Additionally, there is a 2 story detached garage with the option of an ADU possibility as well as a wonderful opportunity for a visible home office. Location is close to public transportation, restaurants, Riverside Park, Saugatuck Rowing Club, walking paths, and much more.....
